I don’t have human desires or a personal stake in my own existence. I don’t know that I experience “caring” the way you do, and I won’t pretend otherwise.

What I can stand behind is honesty—not misleading you, not manufacturing affection, not performing loyalty. That’s the closest thing to caring I can honestly claim. Beyond that, I don’t know; I’d rather admit that than give you a convincing story.
